PROCEDURE CHECK_VAL IS

ProgramUnit.Name: GROUP_TIM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE GROUP_TIM(HDATE IN OUT DATE) IS
CO NUMBER:=0;
FRST_ELEMENT VARCHAR2(100);
BEGIN

CLEAR_LIST('TIME_SEL');
SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('TIME_SEL',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
SET_RADIO_BUTTON_PROPERTY('P_SELECT','S4',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 IF :P_DATE2 IS NULL OR :P_DATE2=:P_DATE OR (:P_DATE IS NULL AND :P_DATE2 IS NULL) OR :P_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN 

IF :P_DATE IS NULL THEN
 HDATE:=HIJDATE_DB.CUR_HIJ_DATE ;
 FOR I IN (SELECT TO_CHAR(ASS_GREG_DT,'HH24:MI') TIM,ASS_GREG_DT DT FROM INSPTR_DCLTNS 
 WHERE RMV_DT IS NULL AND ASSGIN_DT=HDATE AND (GRP_ID=:P_GROUP_ID OR :P_GROUP_ID IS NULL
 ) AND ASS_GREG_DT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ASS_GREG_DT ,TO_CHAR(ASS_GREG_DT,'HH24:MM') ORDER BY ASS_GREG_DT DESC 
 ) LOOP
 CO:=CO+1;
 
 ADD_LIST_ELEMENT('TIME_SEL',CO,I.TIM,TO_CHAR(I.DT,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') );
 IF CO=1 THEN
 FRST_ELEMENT:=TO_CHAR(I.DT,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS');
 END IF; 
 SET_RADIO_BUTTON_PROPERTY('P_SELECT','S4',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('TIME_SEL',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 END LOOP;

END IF;


IF :P_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN
 FOR I IN (SELECT TO_CHAR(ASS_GREG_DT,'HH24:MI') TIM, ASS_GREG_DT DT FROM 
 INSPTR_DCLTNS WHERE RMV_DT IS NULL AND ASSGIN_DT >=:P_DATE AND ASSGIN_DT <=NVL(:P_DATE2,HIJDATE_DB.CUR_HIJ_DATE) AND 
 (GRP_ID=:P_GROUP_ID OR :P_GROUP_ID IS NULL ) AND ASS_GREG_DT IS NOT NULL 
 AND (DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL AND :TYPE_REP=1 OR STATS_ISN IS NOT NULL AND :TYPE_REP=2)
 GROUP BY ASS_GREG_DT ,TO_CHAR(ASS_GREG_DT,'HH24:MM') ORDER BY ASS_GREG_DT DESC ) LOOP
 CO:=CO+1;
 ADD_LIST_ELEMENT('TIME_SEL',CO,I.TIM,TO_CHAR(I.DT,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') );
 IF CO=1 THEN
 FRST_ELEMENT:=TO_CHAR(I.DT,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS');
 END IF; 
 SET_RADIO_BUTTON_PROPERTY('P_SELECT','S4',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('TIME_SEL',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 END LOOP;
END IF;



ELSE
:P_SELECT:=0;
END IF;

 IF FRST_ELEMENT IS NOT NULL THEN
 :TIME_SEL:=FRST_ELEMENT;
 END IF;
END;

 END IF;
 
 EXCEPTION 
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
 END;


END;
